pages.heading: What is that?
pages.body:
Zines are little booklets that you make out of one or more pieces of paper. 

The one you have before you is one that makes an eight page booklet out of one piece of paper! You print it, fold it and make one little cut  to create a 8 page book that you can distribute!

pages.heading: Why?
pages.body:
It's a great way to share information or something that's personal to you!  

There's so much to be learn about, and we don't always have a good way to help spread our story!

Maybe you want to tell a story, or give out information about something that you don't think enough people are knowledgable about!

pages.heading: Now let me show you
pages.body: You can type anything here and let people know about the thing that you're passionate about. You can make your text BOLD, italicized, or underlined or change the color!

textBoxes.html: You can also insert text boxes and put text anywhere!
Combine the elements to help tell your story!

To your left you'll see that there are layers! 

You can hide or move those to change what's showing up on top!

pages.heading: What if I'm done?
pages.body: You can export the json file or print it directly from Print Of course you can load a saved json in so you can also share with collaborators! Use your Library to see all the Zines you've worked on and choose from any zines that are hosted.

pages.heading: Now go out and create!
pages.body: There's much to learn and teach, and zines are a great way to do it!
